title: State of a register configuration
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration, let $s$ be a state, let $r$ be a register, let $f$ be an integer-indexed tape of optional Boolean symbols, and let $p$ be an integer. The configuration obtained by replacing register $r$'s tape by $f$, placing its head at $p$, and setting the state to $s$ has state $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is an integer-indexed tape of optional Boolean symbols
